detail: One row per Scottish region (56 regions, male lip cancer 1975-1980, Clayton and Kaldor 1987). The help page fits runMLwiN(log(obs) ~ 1 + perc_aff + offset(offs) + (0 | neigh1) + (1 | area), D = 'Poisson'), section 17.3's model of the MCMC guide (demo MCMCGuide17): a region-level heterogeneity term with one row per level beside a neigh1 term without variance. Sections 17.4 and 17.6 fit the multiple-membership and CAR models over neigh1 to neigh11 and their weights; no term is a grouping factor (hand check #162).
